newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle not well tested, weak tone - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle not well tested, weak tone - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested, but undertone once again lower. Buyer inquiry fair. Seller interest modest.
Slaughter Steers: Load Select and Choice 2-3 1275 lbs 71.00.
Slaughter Heifers: Load Select and Choice 2-3 1125 lbs 71.00.
Dressed Basis Delivered. Steers and heifers not well tested, but undertone lower.
Dressed Basis Steers: Few Select and Choice 2-3 1250 lbs 113.00; pen predominately choice 116.00.
Dressed Basis Heifers: Few Select and Choice 2-3 1100 lbs 113.00.
